pointers.sentence: The settings module is imported when a setting is first read, and a module it imported may read the settings in turn: `django.conf.global_settings`, Django's default settings, cannot import the translation module, which "depends on the settings" (`django/conf/global_settings.py`).

`import_string` imports the module and returns that attribute of it (`django/utils/module_loading.py:import_string`; [Importing by name: `import_string` and `autodiscover_modules`](../utils/importing.md)).

`override_settings` reaches `CACHES` because a receiver of `setting_changed` discards the caches (`django/test/signals.py:clear_cache_handlers`), but not `DEFAULT_EXCEPTION_REPORTER_FILTER` once its filter is made (`django/views/debug.py:get_default_exception_reporter_filter`).

`AppConfig.create` imports a package with `importlib.import_module`, taking the configuration class from its submodule called apps where it finds one, and anything else with `import_string`; the class must subclass `AppConfig` (`django/apps/config.py:AppConfig.create`).

`Apps.populate` makes the configurations once a process, keeps them in the app registry, imports each application's models module, and last calls each `AppConfig.ready` once, the place for an application's startup code (`django/apps/registry.py:Apps.populate`).

Django also looks inside each installed application by name: for its template tags, commands, migrations and translations with no setting, and for its templates and static files where the settings ask (`django/db/migrations/loader.py:MigrationLoader.migrations_module`; [Settings, apps and startup](../startup.md)).

Each entry of `MIDDLEWARE` is the dotted path of a **factory**: `BaseHandler.load_middleware` imports it and calls it once with the layer inside it, and what it returns is the middleware, called for each request (`django/core/handlers/base.py:BaseHandler.load_middleware`).

DEP 5, a Django Enhancement Proposal, rejected a middleware that is a function of the request and the next layer: it left no place for setup done once or for disabling, and Django would have built a chain of closures for each request, where a factory's is built once (`deps:final/0005-improved-middleware.rst`).

`caches`, `task_backends` and `connections` are each a `BaseConnectionHandler`, which keeps backends in a `Local`, one for each thread or asynchronous context (`django/utils/connection.py:BaseConnectionHandler.__getitem__`); `ConnectionHandler`'s is never shared between threads, for the reason [Django's neighbours](neighbours.md) gives (`django/db/utils.py:ConnectionHandler`).

`storages` and `engines` keep one for each alias in a dictionary all threads share (`django/core/files/storage/handler.py:StorageHandler`).

`TEMPLATES` is a list, and a backend's alias is its `"NAME"` or else the next-to-last name of its path, `"django"` for `DjangoTemplates`; `engines` makes the backend the first time its alias is asked for, as the system checks and `get_template` do for every engine, and keeps it for the process (`django/template/utils.py:EngineHandler`, `django/template/loader.py:get_template`).

`mailers` makes a new backend at each access, because mail backends had always been made for one sending, DEP 18 says (`django/core/mail/handler.py:MailersHandler.create_connection`, `deps:accepted/0018-mailers.md`).

| `AUTH_PASSWORD_VALIDATORS`: dictionaries, a class in each `"NAME"` ([Authentication, sessions and messages](../auth.md)) | `django/contrib/auth/password_validation.py:get_password_validators` | once a process |
| `AUTHENTICATION_BACKENDS`: each a `BaseBackend` ([Authentication, sessions and messages](../auth.md)) | `django/contrib/auth/__init__.py:load_backend` | once a use |
| `CSRF_FAILURE_VIEW`: a view ([Security](../security.md)) | by `get_callable`: `django/middleware/csrf.py:_get_failure_view` | once a process |
| `DATABASE_ROUTERS`: paths of router classes, or routers; no base class ([Database backends](../backends.md)) | `django/db/utils.py:ConnectionRouter.routers` | once a process |

| `DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD`: a subclass of `AutoField`, tested ([Models and fields](../models.md)) | `django/db/models/options.py:Options._get_default_pk_class` | once a model without its own primary key |
| `DEFAULT_EXCEPTION_REPORTER`: an `ExceptionReporter` ([Views](../views.md)) | `django/views/debug.py:get_exception_reporter_class` | once a use |
| `DEFAULT_EXCEPTION_REPORTER_FILTER`: a `SafeExceptionReporterFilter` ([Views](../views.md)) | `django/views/debug.py:get_default_exception_reporter_filter` | once a process |
| `FILE_UPLOAD_HANDLERS`: each a `FileUploadHandler` ([Requests and responses](../http.md)) | `django/http/request.py:HttpRequest._initialize_handlers` | once a request |
| `FORM_RENDERER`: a `BaseRenderer` ([Forms](../forms.md)) | `django/forms/renderers.py:get_default_renderer` | once a process |
| `FORMAT_MODULE_PATH`: packages of format modules by locale ([Internationalization and time zones](../i18n.md)) | by module: `django/utils/formats.py:iter_format_modules` | once a language |

| `LOGGING_CONFIG`: a function, given `LOGGING` ([Settings, apps and startup](../startup.md)) | `django/utils/log.py:configure_logging` | once, by `django.setup`; called only if `LOGGING` is not empty |
| `MESSAGE_STORAGE`: a `BaseStorage` ([Authentication, sessions and messages](../auth.md)) | `django/contrib/messages/storage/__init__.py:default_storage` | once a request |
| `MIGRATION_MODULES`: an application's migrations package ([Migrations](../migrations.md)) | by module: `django/db/migrations/loader.py:MigrationLoader.load_disk` | once a loader |
| `PASSWORD_HASHERS`: each a `BasePasswordHasher` ([Authentication, sessions and messages](../auth.md)) | `django/contrib/auth/hashers.py:get_hashers` | once a process |
| `ROOT_URLCONF`, no default: the root URLconf ([URL routing](../urls.md)) | by module: `django/urls/resolvers.py:URLResolver.urlconf_module` | once a process |

| `SERIALIZATION_MODULES`, no default: a module for each format ([Caching, files, mail, signals and tasks](../services.md)) | by module: `django/core/serializers/__init__.py:_load_serializers` | once a process |

| `SESSION_ENGINE`: a module with a `SessionBase` store ([Authentication, sessions and messages](../auth.md)) | by module: `django/contrib/sessions/middleware.py:SessionMiddleware.__init__` | the module once a process; a store once a request |

| `SESSION_SERIALIZER`: a class like `django.core.signing.JSONSerializer` ([Authentication, sessions and messages](../auth.md)) | `django/contrib/sessions/backends/base.py:SessionBase.__init__` | once a session store |
| `SIGNING_BACKEND`: a `Signer` ([Security](../security.md)) | `django/core/signing.py:get_cookie_signer` | once a use |
| `STATICFILES_FINDERS`: each a `BaseFinder`, tested ([Content types, static files and the other contrib apps](../contrib.md)) | `django/contrib/staticfiles/finders.py:get_finder` | once a process |

| `TEMPLATES`' `"OPTIONS"`: loaders, each a `django.template.loaders.base.Loader`; context processors; tag modules ([Templates](../templates.md)) | tag modules by module: `django/template/engine.py:Engine` | once an engine |
| `TEST_RUNNER`: a `DiscoverRunner` ([The test framework](../testing.md)) | by `__import__`: `django/test/utils.py:get_runner` | once a test run |
| `WSGI_APPLICATION`: the application itself ([Management commands](../commands.md)) | `django/core/servers/basehttp.py:get_internal_wsgi_application` | once, by runserver |
*"Tested": the class is checked against its base. "No default": not in `django/conf/global_settings.py`.*

| template tag libraries: modules with a `Library` | each application's templatetags package (`django/template/backends/django.py:get_template_tag_modules`) | once an engine | [Templates](../templates.md) |

| lookups and transforms: `Lookup` and `Transform` classes, tested on use | `django/db/models/query_utils.py:RegisterLookupMixin.register_class_lookup` | held by the class, or the field, it is registered on; an instance for each filter | [QuerySets](../querysets.md) |

| system checks: functions that return messages | `django/core/checks/registry.py:CheckRegistry.register` | held for the process; called at each run of the checks | [Management commands](../commands.md) |

| the admin: its site, a class `SimpleAdminConfig.default_site` names; a `ModelAdmin` for each model | `django/contrib/admin/sites.py:DefaultAdminSite._setup`; `AdminSite.register`, called from each application's admin module | once a process | [The admin](../admin.md) |

| management commands: each a `BaseCommand` | each application's management/commands directory (`django/core/management/__init__.py:get_commands`) | the list once a process; a command once a use | [Management commands](../commands.md) |

The project's code connects a function, a **receiver**, to a `Signal` that Django made, and Django calls the receivers when it sends the signal, as a request starts and finishes or a model is saved (`django/dispatch/dispatcher.py:Signal.send`).
